rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something happens after the expected time or deadline.

example.english: I handed in my homework late.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ci4 zo2 gaau1 fan6 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use 遲 as the all-purpose choice for something happening after the expected time, including an event occurring near the end of a period.

example.english: Today's flight arrived two hours late.
example.traditional: 今日班機遲咗兩個鐘先到。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 baan1 gei1 ci4 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 sin1 dou3

rows.note: Use 晏 specifically when it is late in the day or at night.

example.english: You shouldn't go to bed so late tonight.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 maan1 m4 hou2 gam3 aan3 fan3

rows.note: Use this for something that happened recently, rather than for being behind schedule.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 si3 gwo3 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use 最近 when late means recent in relation to a past event or period.

example.english: The late developments have benefited the company.
example.traditional: 最近嘅發展對公司有利。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 ge3 faat3 zin2 deoi3 gung1 si1 jau5 lei6

rows.note: Use 已故 before a person's name or relationship term when referring respectfully to someone who has died.

example.english: The works of the late writer Louis Cha are still very popular.
example.traditional: 已故作家金庸嘅作品到而家都仲係好受歡迎。
example.jyutping: ji5 gu3 zok3 gaa1 gam1 jung1 ge3 zok3 ban2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung6 hai6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4
